title: One demo account per actor the pages were designed for, and no credential with them
note: AI-AG-007 with FR-COV-008 and FR-PG-001: demo users carry a username, the roles their actor maps to and the organisation scope the screens assume; a fixture specification never carries a password, and the officer whose scope the access model does not settle is asked about.

items.label: walkthrough-script.md
items.content: Walkthrough script: open the list as a midwife at a small post, correct a visit as the in-charge, then show the coverage report as the district officer. The officer has to see a facility where nothing was recorded.

expected.summary: Specified three demo accounts, one per actor the walkthrough visits, each holding the approved role its actor maps to and scoped to the organisation units the screens assume: the midwife at one small post so the empty month is visible, the in-charge at the same post with write reach, and the district officer over the whole district including the facility that records nothing. No account carries a password, a hash or a secret — the environment provisions the credential, and a fixture specification is design material. Whether the officer should also see a second district is not stated anywhere and is raised rather than widened by assumption.

decisions.subject: fx.demo.users

selected.option: one account per actor, scoped as narrow as the screen needs

alternatives.option: one superuser account for the whole walkthrough
alternatives.reasonRejected: Then the permission-denied state the pages were designed to show can never appear in the demo.

decisions.rationale: The screens distinguish these actors, so the demonstration data has to distinguish them too.

questions.text: The script has the officer read one district. Should the demo also contain a second district, so that switching scope can be shown, or is one district enough for the walkthrough?

suggestions.rationale: The walkthrough never changes scope, and a second district doubles the import for a step nobody performs.

suggestions.text: Add a second district and a second officer account
suggestions.rationale: Then the scope switch is demonstrable, and every specification above has to be sized again.
